scope: One complete main-article walkthrough: deployment, model check, 16 S3-ingested documents, signed requests, smoke and ingestion checks, baseline and synthetic-identifier evaluations, latency probe, one 60-request ABBA retry comparison, and cleanup. Optional external datasets are excluded.
disclaimer: Illustrative assumptions, not measured AWS usage, a quote, a bill, or a spending cap. Public on-demand rates before free tier, discounts, and tax. Actual invocation time, retries, transfer, data volumes, request counts, Region, retained resources, and account usage may differ. SQS and transfer are rounded allowances, not verified rate quotations.

items.assumptions: 300 invocations, 3 billed seconds each, 3072 MB, and 0.01 GB total data in and out

500 QueryVectors requests; 500 other requests; 0.002 GB written and stored for one hour; 500 queries processing 0.002 GB of vector and text data each; responses under the per-query returned-data allowance
300 requests and 300 GB-seconds of x86 compute, first-tier rates
0.15 GB of deployment artifacts for 24 hours, 200 PUT/LIST and 500 GET requests
0.02 GB ingested into Standard log class and stored for 24 hours
Combined rounded allowance for a small amount of queue activity and internet egress; not a service rate or usage measurement
